design.model: authors model 19 (RL+CK), released Q0, scoring pi=0, bias fixed 2.5
design.fold: fit S1-S4 training choices; score S5 by causal replay with carried Q and K (previously inspected validation)
design.starts: 200 R-seeded starts per condition (seed 1234+17*index; identical across conditions) plus warm starts from the other two conditions' optima
design.s1_early: first 0.333 of each participant's S1 trials

profile.starts: saved/refit nuisance + 20 random (seed 20261107) + warm sweeps (E3 protocol)

design.effect_sign: alternative minus C0; positive = alternative worse
design.final_test: never read: permitted_inputs exposes only training/initialization tables
